decisions.reason: The module has its own page and fits the modular sensing platform, so sunk investment and public commitment make dropping unlikely even if results disappoint.
As the third generation of a core measurement module with an established customer base, the firm is highly committed and very unlikely to withdraw it.
The MQTT proxy is central to the announced software and connectivity direction and has visible public commitment, so escalation pressures strongly favor keeping it.
Although only mentioned on the website, CAN bus is a standard industrial interface that supports the platform, and sunk development costs still outweigh the lower visibility.
The CO2 sensor module has its own page and complements the environmental sensing line, so public commitment and platform fit make dropping improbable.
The touch panel accessory is publicly presented and adds usability to the platform, so the firm will likely persist with it despite any early disappointment.
